name: Hoshina Hime
source: Lazy and capricious, she always worries her imouto Maria. Because her growth period is long past, her size will always be small. Her only large size is her arrogant attitude. Because she thinks its too troublesome, other than her hidden qualities and physical abilities, she has a high standard for everything else. She is extremely thankful towards the headmaster for her kindness towards her future and despair. Even after graduation she still lives at school.
